_doc: OKRs, value proposition and value-recognition score for ONE video. Numbers in {braces} are filled from assets/metrics.json (scripts/measure_video.py). Re-run scripts/build_okr.py to refresh preprod.html.
value_proposition: In under 13 minutes a viewer whose Claude app does not show the new Whiteboard learns exactly what to check (Settings > Capabilities, plan, app and Mac updates, old copies), sees what the missing feature looks like, and knows what to do while it has not reached their account.

objectives.title: A viewer who cannot see the new Whiteboard leaves knowing what to check and what to do next

krs.text: The problem is on screen within 10 s
The first concrete action is shown within 30 s
A recap lists at least 4 concrete takeaways at the end
Average view duration of at least 40% (YouTube Analytics, first 28 days)
At least 10 comments saying it helped or that they found the answer (first 28 days)

objectives.title: Turn viewers into Delivery Pilot community members

krs.text: The community card stays on screen at least 8 s with the URL
The URL is in the description and the pinned comment
At least 30 clicks on the Skool link in 14 days
At least 5 new members say this video brought them (join question), 14 days

objectives.title: Ship a clean, private and reusable video, fast

krs.text: No private text visible in the export (OCR check of every 2 s)
Integrated loudness within 1.5 LU of -14 LUFS
True peak at or below -1.5 dBFS
Steady background noise at most 5 dB above the clean part after the fix
Dead air (silence over 3 s) at most 5% of the runtime
Every chapter at least 10 s (YouTube rule)

score.scale: Each dimension 0 to 10 (0 = absent, 5 = present but weak, 8 = good, 10 = excellent and proven). Weighted to 100. This is the producer's pre-publish estimate from measured evidence; replace it with the real numbers after 28 days.

rows.evidence: Thumbnail and title card say the problem plainly ("Claude Whiteboard MISSING?"). But the title ends with "(and the Fix)" while the honest outcome is that the feature had not reached the account yet and the fix is to update and wait.
rows.improve: Retitle to promise what is delivered: "…What to Check While You Wait". Raises clarity and avoids a trust penalty.

rows.evidence: Problem on screen at {time_to_problem_s} s (title card, then "What we are doing" slide); first action (Settings, Capabilities) at {time_to_first_action_s} s.
A picture card shows the expected Whiteboard tile with an arrow, then the live Artifacts page without it; the chat answer is on screen.
rows.improve: Optional: repeat the expected-feature card at the summary.

rows.evidence: Summary lists {summary_points} takeaways; steps are shown live (quit and reopen, update the Mac, remove the old copy). The main answer is "wait", which limits how much a viewer can do.
rows.improve: Add a final checklist slide with the exact menu path and the commands used.

rows.evidence: Dead air {dead_air_percent}% (the silent hoover stretch is cut), {stutter_spots} stutter spots remain in the speech (the captions are cleaned), runtime {export_seconds} s for a mostly negative result; speech pace {words_per_minute} words per minute is fine. Platform cuts exist: LinkedIn 3:19 and X 1:54.
rows.improve: Cut or speed up the {stutter_spots} stutter spots (EDL candidates, owner decides) and trim the first minute of searching: about 20 s shorter.

rows.evidence: Loudness {loudness_lufs} LUFS, true peak {true_peak_dbfs} dBFS (0.3 dB over the -1.5 target), hoover noise now {noise_haze_max_db_after_fix} dB above the clean part, animated captions, no transitions, {blur_boxes} blur boxes and {privacy_leaks} private lines left.
rows.improve: Lower the limiter ceiling by 0.5 dB at export.

rows.evidence: Shows the negative result openly, makes no income or result promises, states it is one account and one Mac, privacy check passed.
{chapters} chapters, shortest {chapter_min_len_s} s; recap at the end; description, tags and pinned comment written.
rows.improve: Put a 5 s teaser of the answer in the first minute.

rows.evidence: Community card after the recap for {cta_seconds} s with the URL; URL also in the description and pinned comment; one ask, no promises.
rows.improve: Say the community name aloud in a final line.

after_publish: Day 2: check impressions click-through and the first 30 s retention against KR1.1 and KR1.4.
Day 14: Skool link clicks (KR2.3) and the join question "Which video brought you here?" (KR2.4).
Day 28: average view duration (KR1.4) and helpful comments (KR1.5); then replace the pre-publish scores with real evidence.
